held.title: The `--start-hidden` check may run before startup dialogs open, so they can end up in a hidden window.
held.body: `Window_OnLoaded` checks `DialogHost.IsOpen` once, inside the `Loaded` handler. Startup dialogs (first-run setup, update prompt) may open from the view model's own loaded or initialization logic, which may run after this handler or after an `await`. If so, `IsOpen` is still false at the check and the window hides. The dialog then opens in an invisible window and the user never sees it. I couldn't see how or when `MainViewModel` opens its startup dialogs, so this depends on that ordering. Fix: decide whether to hide after the view model's startup work has finished, for example by having the view model raise a signal or by checking after its init task completes, rather than reading `DialogHost.IsOpen` once in `Loaded`.
